Verification checklist

A listing cannot be approved until every item is recorded as checked.

  • Official lands search completed✓ Done
  • Owner identity document verified✓ Done
  • Written authority held if an agent is listing✓ Done
  • Surveyor has photographed the property○ Pending
  • Floor plan measured and recorded○ Pending
  • Price confirmed with the owner in writing✓ Done
  • Smart tier checked against the device schedule○ Pending
  • Listing photographs checked against the property○ Pending
